versions.changelog:
No code or documentation changes detected in this release.

- Version bumped from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1.
- No functional or documentation updates included.

web123 v1.1.0

- Added 5 new skills: cex-trader, ta-radar, crypto-social-intel, anti-rug, antalpha-ai-setup, and antalpha-ai-docs (total skills: 18).
- Expanded triggers and matching to support CEX trading, technical analysis, social/KOL signals, and contract security.
- Updated quick reference and output templates for new skill categories and use cases.
- Improved recommendation logic to prioritize new skills for relevant keywords (e.g., CEX, technical analysis, contract risks).
- Enhanced full matrix, category listings, and install guides to include all new skills and packs.

web123 1.2.0 Changelog

- Major documentation update: new detailed SKILL.md explaining skill triggers, recommendation logic, and output templates in English and Chinese.
- Starter pack and category-based recommendations are now documented with example output templates.
- Quick reference table for input→output mapping and common use cases added.
- Full product matrix overview included for all 13 supported AntalphaAI Web3 skills.
- Install commands for individual skills and starter packs clearly listed.
